Why I Make Things

Whether I'm debugging code, hand-cutting dovetail joints, or composing a photograph, the process is similar: understanding the problem, choosing the right tools, and iterating until it's right.

Each pursuit informs the others. The patience learned in woodworking helps with complex coding problems. The attention to detail from photography improves my craftsmanship. The problem-solving from programming applies everywhere.
